core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghaffar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “To forgive”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghaffar corresponds to the Arabic form غفار (Arabic root غ ف ر (gh-f-r); intensive غَفّار (Ghaffār)). Its core sense is ever-forgiving, most forgiving. Ghaffar is Arabic غَفّار (Ghaffār), the intensive form of the root غ ف ر (gh-f-r) 'to forgive' — 'most forgiving, ever-forgiving'. It is one of the divine names in Islamic tradition. The source form غفار (without the shadda) is a normal unvocalised spelling of the same word.
